With flight of Turkish drone | Explosion in Al-Qamishly leaves one killed and three injured

Al-Hasakah province: SOHR activists have reported hearing loud explosion in Al-Qamishly city, due to the explosion of a car in Al-Sina’a Al-Qadima (old industrial) area at Kaziyah Hasko, killing one person and injuring at least three others.

This coincided with the flight of Turkish drones over the region. However, it wasn’t confirmed whether the explosion was caused by the Turkish drones or another cause.
